title: WizardDialog
wrapsNative: MonarchBottomSheet holding MonarchStepper, MonarchText with a polite live region, the step's content and MonarchButton for Back and Continue in a androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
summary: A recipe, not a component: a task of a few steps in a bottom sheet, with a stepper showing progress, the current step's content, Back and Continue, and a danger last step.
whenToUse: For a short task of two to four steps that should not leave the current screen, such as moving a project or setting up an integration.
whenNotToUse: For a long or resumable flow, use full screens with their own back stack. For one question, use a dialog.
api: @Composable fun MonarchStepper(steps: List<MonarchStepperStep>, current: Int, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, furthest: Int? = null, orientation: MonarchStepperOrientation = MonarchStepperOrientation.Horizontal, compact: MonarchStepperCompactMode = MonarchStepperCompactMode.Automatic, onSelect: ((step: MonarchStepperStep, index: Int) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchStepperLabels = MonarchStepperLabels())

@Composable fun MonarchBottomSheet(onDismissRequest: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, description: String? = null, dismissible: Boolean = true, showHandle: Boolean = true, fullyExpanded: Boolean = true, fullWidthContent: Boolean = false, content: @Composable MonarchBottomSheetScope.() -> Unit)

@Composable fun MonarchButton(text: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary, …, enabled: Boolean = true, loading: Boolean = false, …)

states.name: first step
states.description: The stepper at step 1, the step's content and Continue; no Back.

states.name: last step
states.description: The main action is a danger MonarchButton named for what it does, such as "Move project".

states.name: blocked
states.description: Continue is disabled until the step is valid; say why in the step's content.

states.name: working
states.description: Pass loading to the main action while a step's work runs; show a failure with MonarchInlineNotice and stay on the step.

appearance: A Material 3 bottom sheet on the raised surface Monarch maps to it, with MonarchStepper (accent marks for the current and completed steps), the step title in the heading style, a ghost Back and a primary Continue, or a danger last action. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web WizardDialog is a component that takes steps with content, canContinue, blockedReason, a per-step async onContinue with pending and error states, and a done step. On Android the app holds the step index and composes MonarchStepper and MonarchButton in a MonarchBottomSheet. The web moves focus to the step heading; on Android the step title is a polite live region, so TalkBack announces each new step, and the app can move focus with a FocusRequester. Back within the wizard is the Back button; the system back closes the sheet, or add a BackHandler that goes to the previous step. iOS uses the same recipe.
accessibility: MonarchStepper reads the progress ("Step 2 of 3") and each step's state.
The step title is a polite live region, so TalkBack announces the new step after Continue or Back.
The last action is named for what it does, so it does not depend on its danger color.
Back and Continue have 48dp touch targets; a disabled Continue is announced as disabled.
edgeCases: Keep entered values when going Back.
If the sheet is dismissed half way, decide whether to keep the draft; reset the step when it opens again.
